name: Monkey's Gold xPays

features.name: xPays
features.description: Adjacent symbols on reels 1–3 build growing wins.

features.name: Symbol upgrade
features.description: Filling a row upgrades the collected symbols.

review:
A 6x6 jungle with xPays: when symbols land next to each other on the first three reels, non-winners vanish and drop again, and wins grow as more symbols connect.

Colossal 2x2 and 3x3 symbols can carry multipliers up to 500x, with wilds filling the gaps beneath them, and filling a whole row upgrades the collected symbols. Medium volatility, 12,683x max.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
